title: Font Fu: the agreed pairs for Similar
description: For each reference face of the fixture corpus (fixtures/fonts): the faces a person says should rank near it and the faces that should rank far from it. expected.json follows it.

references.description: At least 20 references; no file is a reference twice.

face.description: One face: the default instance of a file of fixtures/fonts.

family.description: The family name, for the reader.

file.description: The path under fixtures/fonts, as fixtures/fonts/manifest.tsv lists it.

reference.description: A reference face. Every near face must rank above every far face. A file is in near or in far, never in both, and never the reference itself.

class.description: What a designer would call the reference. It groups the file for the reader; it is not the app's classification.

note.description: Why these faces: what the eye goes by.
